capabilities: Create deadlines with a title, date, and time
Configure recurring deadlines with a 1-30 day interval
Set advance visual warnings for approaching deadlines (1-24 hours)
View and refresh countdown timers in a sidebar view grouped by category
Delete and rearrange deadlines from the settings menu
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author states the category reordering limitation will not be fixed ('I will NOT improve this later').
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track upcoming deadlines with visible countdowns and advance warnings.
summary: Deadline tracker that shows countdown timers for deadlines in a sidebar view, with recurrence, warnings, and categories.
